strings: m_c has always struggled to empathize with {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} clanmates.
m_c admits that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/have/has} never been able to read emotions, much less empathize with them.
Being autistic, m_c has never been able to connect with other cats in the same way. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} may have low empathy.
When other cats vent to m_c, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} tend to give solutions rather than comfort. r_c0 proposes that m_c has low empathy.
